title: Porsche Taycan new entry-level model rear-wheel drive, two sizes of battery (Porsche newsroom, 2021)
notes: Performance Battery 79.2 kWh gross (single deck), Performance Battery Plus 93.4 kWh gross; max DC 225 kW and 270 kW; 5-80% in 22.5 min; optional on-board charger up to 22 kW (European text). Net capacity not stated.
